turns.text: How to build engagement with a client? Let's imagine, the client is not there for you to sell him. The client is for him to get the solution on the problem that he has. So instead of you telling him, the wrong way is telling him what to do. The right way is to ask the question so you can steer the conversation into the right direction, probing and clarifying, probing and clarifying. Oh, would that make sense for if we book a little bit more time together on a Zoom, so you can walk through the actual numbers and the data from Dubai Land Department for the past three, four years, just to see if this area or this developer or this type of property will be the best investment for you. Does that make sense?
